values.intro: Hudson County Motors is an authorized New Jersey Motor Vehicle diesel emissions inspection center. An emission inspection will take less than a half of an hour and can help identify issues that can trigger fines ranging from $500 to $1,300. Most inspections can be performed the same day. Please call the service department at (201) 866-7666 to schedule your appointment. At the appointment, you will be required to provide the following:
values.body:
Proof of insurance

A current New Jersey registration card that is registered to the vehicle being inspected

Affixed license tags registered to the vehicle being inspected
